# Agent Platform

> An authenticated, multi-tenant AI service that answers questions from each tenant's own documents and runs multi-step research jobs that survive worker crashes.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform

## Source

- [src/agent_platform/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/__init__.py): Agent platform: an authenticated, multi-tenant AI service composed from small libraries.
- [src/agent_platform/agent.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/agent.py): The agent runtime: one place that answers a tenant's question.
- [src/agent_platform/api.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/api.py): The HTTP API: a threaded standard-library server in front of the platform.
- [src/agent_platform/app.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/app.py): The composition root: one object that wires every component to one database.
- [src/agent_platform/auth.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/auth.py): API keys: issuance, hashed storage, verification, and revocation.
- [src/agent_platform/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/cli.py): Command-line interface: ``agent-platform <command>``.
- [src/agent_platform/client.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/client.py): A minimal standard-library HTTP client for the platform API.
- [src/agent_platform/config.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/config.py): Runtime settings, read from explicit arguments or ``AGENT_PLATFORM_*`` variables.
- [src/agent_platform/corpus.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/corpus.py): A small fixed corpus and question set used by the demo, the eval suite, and tests.
- [src/agent_platform/db.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/db.py): SQLite storage: schema, per-thread connections, and explicit write transactions.
- [src/agent_platform/demo.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/demo.py): ``agent-platform demo``: an end-to-end scenario on a fresh local database.
- [src/agent_platform/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/evaluation.py): The platform eval suite, built on ``evaluation_harness``.
- [src/agent_platform/jobs.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/jobs.py): Durable job storage: submission, lease-based claiming, checkpoints, and a step ledger.
- [src/agent_platform/knowledge.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/knowledge.py): Per-tenant knowledge bases: durable documents and cached hybrid retrievers.
- [src/agent_platform/mcp_server.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/mcp_server.py): An MCP server (stdio transport) that exposes the platform to MCP clients.
- [src/agent_platform/metrics.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/metrics.py): A small thread-safe metrics registry rendered in the Prometheus text format.
- [src/agent_platform/model.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/model.py): The language-model path: a deterministic offline provider behind the safety gateway.
- [src/agent_platform/orchestration.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/orchestration.py): Multi-agent jobs built on ``multi_agent_orchestrator``.
- [src/agent_platform/processes.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/processes.py): Helpers for running workers as separate operating-system processes.
- [src/agent_platform/providers.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/providers.py): Hosted model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) and the factory that selects one.
- [src/agent_platform/structured.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/structured.py): Structured answers via schema-constrained decoding.
- [src/agent_platform/tracing.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/tracing.py): Trace persistence on top of ``llm_observability``.
- [src/agent_platform/vectors.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/vectors.py): A vector retriever: hashed embeddings indexed in an HNSW graph.
- [src/agent_platform/worker.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/agent-platform/blob/main/src/agent_platform/worker.py): The job worker: claim, heartbeat, execute step by step, checkpoint, finish.
